risks.title: Cybersecurity failure and data protection
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions cybersecurity as a major risk overseen by the board of directors and the audit committee. The language intensity is moderate, but the topic is central for a technology company. The context shows ongoing attention to this risk.

risks.title: Decline in revenue and product sales
risks.score_rationale: The report details a significant decline in total revenue (-4.9%) and units sold (-7.5%) for fiscal year 2025 compared to 2024. The language is factual, but the trend is clearly negative and directly impacts performance.

risks.title: Impact of litigation and associated costs
risks.score_rationale: Although the company states it is not involved in any proceedings having a material adverse effect, it acknowledges that litigation could have a negative impact due to defense costs and the diversion of managerial resources.

risks.title: Dependence on Sonos speakers revenue
risks.score_rationale: Revenue from 'Sonos speakers' represents 77.7% of the total, indicating high concentration. Declines in this category have a disproportionate impact on overall results.

risks.title: Growing net loss
risks.score_rationale: The report shows an increase in net loss from $38.1 million in 2024 to $61.1 million in 2025. Although adjusted EBITDA is positive, the net loss indicates financial pressure.

risks.title: Restructuring and transformation costs
risks.score_rationale: Significant charges related to restructuring and transformation are noted for 2025 ($33.5 million). These costs directly impact financial results and may indicate operational challenges.
